sentence: This project builds statistical tools that analyze data that take the form of probability distributions rather than single numbers.
This project builds blockchain learning modules and hands-on labs to improve cybersecurity education.
This project studies the process of 3D printing soft elastomers to find out why the printed parts have poor quality.
This project studies how an enzyme that removes methyl groups from DNA is targeted to specific places in the genome and how RNA affects it.
This project studies how a soybean enzyme helps soybean plants resist the soybean cyst nematode.
This project studies how life works at many levels, from molecules and cells to whole organisms.
This project studies how soil layers and wet and dry periods affect water, carbon, and nitrogen cycling in soils.
This project operates radars that observe plasma motions in the upper atmosphere of Earth and supports research using them.
This project studies how freshwater input and sea ice affect trace metals and the food web in the Siberian Arctic.
This project tests whether the many different chemical compounds in plants mainly come from the selective pressures on fruit chemistry.
This project builds AI systems that turn images, text or sound into lists of numbers so that learned knowledge can be reused.
This project studies why solid-state batteries lose performance over time by separating three internal breakdown processes.
This project builds AI models that analyze raw data to predict and detect faults where wind farms connect to the grid.
This project builds a robotic system that detects cognitive fatigue in people with spinal cord injury and changes how it helps them.
This project studies transport processes at nanoscale interfaces in molecular devices, metal 3D-printed parts, and nanostructured fluids.
This project tries to make superconductors with spin-symmetric electron pairs in thin layered materials and builds a microwave spectrometer to detect them.
